question: How many pathways does the graph hold?
paraphrases: How many Reactome pathways are in the graph?
cypher: MATCH (p:Pathway) RETURN count(p) AS pathways

question: How many Gene Ontology terms are in the graph?
cypher: MATCH (g:GOTerm) RETURN count(g) AS go_terms

question: How many Gene Ontology terms are there in each namespace (biological process, molecular function, cellular component)?
paraphrases: Break the GO terms down by namespace.
cypher: MATCH (g:GOTerm) WHERE g.namespace IS NOT NULL RETURN g.namespace AS namespace, count(*) AS terms ORDER BY terms DESC

question: How many protein complexes are in the graph?
cypher: MATCH (c:Complex) RETURN count(c) AS complexes

question: How many reactions does the graph record?
cypher: MATCH (r:Reaction) RETURN count(r) AS reactions

question: How many protein-protein interactions are recorded?
paraphrases: How many protein interaction links does the graph have?
cypher: MATCH (:Protein)-[i:INTERACTS_WITH]->(:Protein) RETURN count(i) AS interactions

question: What is the name of the Reactome pathway {pathway_id}?
cypher: MATCH (p:Pathway {pathway_id: $pathway_id}) RETURN p.name AS pathway

question: What is the GO term GO:0006915 called, and which namespace is it in?
cypher: MATCH (g:GOTerm {go_id: 'GO:0006915'}) RETURN g.name AS name, g.namespace AS namespace

question: What is the UniProt accession of the protein {protein}?
cypher: MATCH (p:Protein {name: $protein}) RETURN p.uniprot_id AS accession

question: Which gene name does the protein with UniProt accession Q09472 carry?
cypher: MATCH (p:Protein {uniprot_id: 'Q09472'}) RETURN p.name AS gene_name

question: Which pathways are top-level, with no parent pathway above them?
paraphrases: List the root pathways of the Reactome hierarchy.
cypher: MATCH (p:Pathway) WHERE NOT (p)-[:CHILD_OF]->(:Pathway) RETURN p.name AS pathway ORDER BY pathway

question: How many interaction partners does {protein} have?
cypher: MATCH (p:Protein {name: $protein})-[:INTERACTS_WITH]-(o:Protein) RETURN count(DISTINCT o) AS partners

question: How many proteins take part in the {pathway} pathway?
cypher: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:PARTICIPATES_IN]->(pw:Pathway {name: $pathway}) RETURN count(DISTINCT p) AS proteins

question: How many Gene Ontology terms are obsolete, that is, have a name starting with 'obsolete'?
cypher: MATCH (g:GOTerm) WHERE g.name STARTS WITH 'obsolete' RETURN count(g) AS obsolete_terms

question: How many amino acids long is the MAPK1 protein?
cypher: MATCH (p:Protein {name: 'MAPK1'}) WHERE p.sequence_length IS NOT NULL RETURN p.sequence_length AS length

question: Which ten proteins have the most interaction partners?
paraphrases: What are the ten biggest hubs in the protein interaction network?
cypher: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:INTERACTS_WITH]-(o:Protein) RETURN p.name AS protein, count(DISTINCT o) AS partners ORDER BY partners DESC, protein LIMIT 10

question: Which ten proteins, by UniProt accession, take part in the most pathways?
cypher: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:PARTICIPATES_IN]->(pw:Pathway) RETURN p.uniprot_id AS accession, count(DISTINCT pw) AS pathways ORDER BY pathways DESC, accession LIMIT 10

question: Which ten pathways involve the most proteins?
paraphrases: What are the ten largest pathways by number of proteins?
cypher: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:PARTICIPATES_IN]->(pw:Pathway) RETURN pw.name AS pathway, count(DISTINCT p) AS proteins ORDER BY proteins DESC, pathway LIMIT 10

question: Which pathways sit directly under {pathway}?
paraphrases: What are the immediate sub-pathways of {pathway}?
cypher: MATCH (c:Pathway)-[:CHILD_OF]->(:Pathway {name: $pathway}) RETURN c.name AS sub_pathway ORDER BY sub_pathway

question: Which pathway or pathways is {pathway} directly part of?
cypher: MATCH (:Pathway {name: $pathway})-[:CHILD_OF]->(p:Pathway) RETURN p.name AS parent ORDER BY parent

question: Which pathways does the protein with UniProt accession {accession} take part in?
cypher: MATCH (:Protein {uniprot_id: $accession})-[:PARTICIPATES_IN]->(pw:Pathway) RETURN pw.name AS pathway ORDER BY pathway

question: How many GO terms is the protein with UniProt accession {accession} annotated with in each namespace?
cypher: MATCH (:Protein {uniprot_id: $accession})-[:ANNOTATED_WITH]->(g:GOTerm) RETURN g.namespace AS namespace, count(DISTINCT g) AS terms ORDER BY terms DESC, namespace

question: Which proteins interact with {protein} with a confidence score of at least {min_score}?
cypher: MATCH (:Protein {name: $protein})-[i:INTERACTS_WITH]-(o:Protein) WHERE i.combined_score >= $min_score RETURN DISTINCT o.name AS partner ORDER BY partner

question: Which broader GO terms is 'apoptotic process' directly a kind of, one level up?
paraphrases: What are the direct is-a parents of the GO term apoptotic process?
cypher: MATCH (:GOTerm {name: 'apoptotic process'})-[:IS_A]->(p:GOTerm) RETURN p.go_id AS go_id, p.name AS name ORDER BY go_id

question: How many GO terms are direct subtypes of 'programmed cell death'?
cypher: MATCH (c:GOTerm)-[:IS_A]->(:GOTerm {name: 'programmed cell death'}) RETURN count(DISTINCT c) AS subtypes

question: How many proteins are annotated with the GO term 'apoptotic process'?
cypher: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:ANNOTATED_WITH]->(:GOTerm {name: 'apoptotic process'}) RETURN count(DISTINCT p) AS proteins

question: How many protein-to-pathway memberships are traceable author statements (TAS) and how many are electronically inferred (IEA)?
cypher: MATCH (:Protein)-[r:PARTICIPATES_IN]->(:Pathway) RETURN r.evidence AS evidence, count(*) AS memberships ORDER BY memberships DESC

question: Which ten GO terms are used to annotate the most proteins?
cypher: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:ANNOTATED_WITH]->(g:GOTerm) RETURN g.name AS term, count(DISTINCT p) AS proteins ORDER BY proteins DESC, term LIMIT 10

question: Which five {namespace} GO terms annotate the most proteins?
cypher: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:ANNOTATED_WITH]->(g:GOTerm {namespace: $namespace}) RETURN g.name AS term, count(DISTINCT p) AS proteins ORDER BY proteins DESC, term LIMIT 5

question: What are the lowest, highest and average confidence scores of the protein interactions, with the average rounded to one decimal?
cypher: MATCH (:Protein)-[i:INTERACTS_WITH]->(:Protein) RETURN min(i.combined_score) AS lowest, max(i.combined_score) AS highest, round(avg(i.combined_score) * 10) / 10.0 AS average

question: Which five pathways have the most direct sub-pathways?
cypher: MATCH (c:Pathway)-[:CHILD_OF]->(p:Pathway) RETURN p.name AS pathway, count(DISTINCT c) AS sub_pathways ORDER BY sub_pathways DESC, pathway LIMIT 5

question: Which five protein complexes have the most protein components?
cypher: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:COMPONENT_OF]->(c:Complex) RETURN c.name AS complex, count(DISTINCT p) AS components ORDER BY components DESC, complex LIMIT 5

question: How many protein components does the complex with Reactome identifier R-HSA-749445 have?
cypher: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:COMPONENT_OF]->(:Complex {complex_id: 'R-HSA-749445'}) RETURN count(DISTINCT p) AS components

question: How many GO annotations are there for each evidence code?
paraphrases: Break the protein GO annotations down by evidence code.
cypher: MATCH (:Protein)-[a:ANNOTATED_WITH]->(:GOTerm) RETURN a.evidence_code AS evidence_code, count(*) AS annotations ORDER BY annotations DESC, evidence_code

question: How many proteins have at least one GO annotation backed by evidence code {code}?
cypher: MATCH (p:Protein)-[a:ANNOTATED_WITH]->(:GOTerm) WHERE a.evidence_code = $code RETURN count(DISTINCT p) AS proteins

question: How many pathways have the word 'signaling' in their name, ignoring case?
cypher: MATCH (p:Pathway) WHERE toLower(p.name) CONTAINS 'signaling' RETURN count(p) AS pathways

question: How many pathways sit directly under more than one parent pathway?
cypher: MATCH (c:Pathway)-[:CHILD_OF]->(p:Pathway) WITH c, count(DISTINCT p) AS parents WHERE parents > 1 RETURN count(c) AS pathways

question: Which larger GO terms is 'mitotic spindle elongation' directly part of?
cypher: MATCH (:GOTerm {name: 'mitotic spindle elongation'})-[:PART_OF]->(w:GOTerm) RETURN w.name AS whole ORDER BY whole

question: Which approved drugs target {protein}?
cypher: MATCH (d:Drug)-[:TARGETS]->(:Protein {name: $protein}) RETURN d.name AS drug ORDER BY drug

question: In which tissue is TP53 most highly expressed?
cypher: MATCH (p:Protein {name: 'TP53'}) WHERE p.top_tissue IS NOT NULL RETURN p.top_tissue AS tissue

question: How many pathways lie anywhere beneath {pathway} in the pathway hierarchy?
paraphrases: Counting every level, how many sub-pathways does {pathway} have?
cypher: MATCH (c:Pathway)-[:CHILD_OF*1..]->(:Pathway {name: $pathway}) RETURN count(DISTINCT c) AS pathways

question: Which top-level pathways does 'Retinoid metabolism and transport' ultimately belong to?
cypher: MATCH (:Pathway {name: 'Retinoid metabolism and transport'})-[:CHILD_OF*1..]->(r:Pathway) WHERE NOT (r)-[:CHILD_OF]->(:Pathway) RETURN DISTINCT r.name AS top_level ORDER BY top_level

question: Following is-a links all the way up, which GO terms is GO:0006915 a kind of?
cypher: MATCH (:GOTerm {go_id: 'GO:0006915'})-[:IS_A*1..]->(a:GOTerm) RETURN DISTINCT a.go_id AS go_id, a.name AS name ORDER BY go_id

question: How many interaction partners do {protein_a} and {protein_b} have in common?
cypher: MATCH (:Protein {name: $protein_a})-[:INTERACTS_WITH]-(x:Protein)-[:INTERACTS_WITH]-(:Protein {name: $protein_b}) RETURN count(DISTINCT x) AS shared_partners

question: How many proteins take part in both {pathway_a} and {pathway_b}?
cypher: MATCH (:Pathway {name: $pathway_a})<-[:PARTICIPATES_IN]-(p:Protein)-[:PARTICIPATES_IN]->(:Pathway {name: $pathway_b}) RETURN count(DISTINCT p) AS proteins

question: Which interaction partners of {protein} also take part in the {pathway} pathway?
cypher: MATCH (:Protein {name: $protein})-[:INTERACTS_WITH]-(o:Protein)-[:PARTICIPATES_IN]->(:Pathway {name: $pathway}) RETURN DISTINCT o.name AS partner ORDER BY partner

question: Which five biological-process GO terms are most common among the interaction partners of {protein}?
cypher: MATCH (:Protein {name: $protein})-[:INTERACTS_WITH]-(o:Protein)-[:ANNOTATED_WITH]->(g:GOTerm {namespace: 'biological_process'}) RETURN g.name AS process, count(DISTINCT o) AS partners ORDER BY partners DESC, process LIMIT 5

question: Which five molecular-function GO terms are most common among the proteins in the {pathway} pathway?
cypher: MATCH (:Pathway {name: $pathway})<-[:PARTICIPATES_IN]-(p:Protein)-[:ANNOTATED_WITH]->(g:GOTerm {namespace: 'molecular_function'}) RETURN g.name AS function, count(DISTINCT p) AS proteins ORDER BY proteins DESC, function LIMIT 5

question: Which five other pathways share the most proteins with {pathway}?
cypher: MATCH (:Pathway {name: $pathway})<-[:PARTICIPATES_IN]-(p:Protein)-[:PARTICIPATES_IN]->(o:Pathway) WHERE o.name <> $pathway RETURN o.name AS pathway, count(DISTINCT p) AS shared_proteins ORDER BY shared_proteins DESC, pathway LIMIT 5

question: How many protein interactions are there in which both partners take part in the {pathway} pathway?
cypher: MATCH (pw:Pathway {name: $pathway})<-[:PARTICIPATES_IN]-(a:Protein)-[i:INTERACTS_WITH]->(b:Protein)-[:PARTICIPATES_IN]->(pw) RETURN count(DISTINCT i) AS interactions

question: For each top-level pathway, how many pathways lie anywhere beneath it? List the five largest.
cypher: MATCH (r:Pathway) WHERE NOT (r)-[:CHILD_OF]->(:Pathway) MATCH (c:Pathway)-[:CHILD_OF*1..]->(r) RETURN r.name AS top_level, count(DISTINCT c) AS pathways ORDER BY pathways DESC, top_level LIMIT 5

question: Which interaction partners of {protein} are expressed in the liver?
cypher: MATCH (:Protein {name: $protein})-[:INTERACTS_WITH]-(o:Protein)-[:EXPRESSED_IN]->(:Tissue {name: 'liver'}) RETURN DISTINCT o.name AS partner ORDER BY partner
